quests.flowRule: Strong Forms: a stranded preposition keeps its full vowel.

quests.instruction: Shadow at speed. Which word is the nuclear stress?
quests.word: You know what, I think we're better off just sticking with what we've got.
quests.textToSpeak: You know what, I think we're better off just sticking with what we've got.
options: 'better'
'sticking'
'got'
quests.ipa: /jə ˈnəʊ ˈwɒt | aɪ ˈθɪŋk wɪə ˈbetər ˈɒf dʒəst ˈstɪkɪŋ wɪð wɒt wiv ˈɡɒt/
quests.hint: Find the last content word.
quests.explanation: 'Got' ends the sentence, so it takes the nuclear stress even though it is a plain verb.
quests.flowRule: Nuclear Stress: the final stressed word takes the peak.

quests.instruction: Shadow at speed. How does 'I'm easy' sound?
quests.word: I really don't mind either way, so you choose, I'm easy.
quests.textToSpeak: I really don't mind either way, so you choose, I'm easy.
options: Loud and sharp, like a warning
Light and falling
Rising, like a question to the listener
quests.ipa: /aɪ ˈrɪəli ˈdəʊnt ˈmaɪnd ˈaɪðə ˈweɪ | səʊ jə ˈtʃuːz | aɪm ˈiːzi/
quests.hint: Say the casual ending as if you really don't care.
quests.explanation: A light, falling 'I'm easy' sounds relaxed and open.
quests.flowRule: Casual Tone: a light fall sounds relaxed.
